material_findings: All 25 completed experiments have preregistration creation before result creation; WP016 has two preregistrations and no results or trials.
The work-package chronology registry stopped at an unfinished WP007 entry; it was extended without rewriting historical reports.
BTC 1m/1h/4h, order-flow, ALFRED and funding identities, cutoffs, hashes and installed-data semantics reconcile.
The Wikimedia series is complete and content-addressed, but its retrieved historical values are not a point-in-time vintage dataset.

Historical BAR_CLOSE to SIGNAL_DECISION to same-boundary NEXT_1M_OPEN execution is internally consistent; the entry bar is the minute opening at the signal boundary and expiry is exactly t+1440 minutes.
The manual paper action could occur after that entry minute was observed and then reconstruct it; production creation is now fail-closed pending a versioned causal design.
F1-F8, ALIGNED gates, NFCI, funding and attention transforms have correct closed-window/as-of code semantics; only the external Wikimedia vintage premise remains unproven.

OLS, EWLS, regime/context models and HGBR obey train-only fitting, 216h purge, complete-label containment and strict prediction > 0. HGBR uses scikit-learn 1.7.2 pinned exactly; future model versions should spell out every upstream default for easier review.

WP005 reconciliation is STRONG; WP008 and WP011-WP016 model reconcilers are PARTIAL because they independently reconstruct model predictions but share production feature/label/execution substrate. No major reconciler is circular or merely compares the same result object.
Committed WP003-WP015 arithmetic, fold totals, profile trade counts, cost monotonicity and matched-universe disclosures are internally consistent.

ALIGNED remains an INCONCLUSIVE PAPER_RESEARCH_CANDIDATE: it is the strongest development clue, but it lacks consistent annual breadth and has no forward or sealed evidence. No implementation defect warrants changing that status.
No genuine paper trade exists, so no prospective evidence was contaminated.
New entry creation is disabled because manual analysis cannot causally obtain the already-observed signal-boundary open.
Atomic persistence now uses unique staging files, read-modify-write lifecycle operations are serialized, and unsafe persisted safety fields are rejected.
Candidate and request allowlists prevent arbitrary command/path/config execution.
A second live backend instance no longer misclassifies an active run as interrupted; PID-aware locks distinguish live and dead owners.
NEW_EXPERIMENT candidates are one-shot after any persisted local attempt.
Blocked candidate status is enforced server-side and WP016 is non-runnable.
Authoritative scientific values remain backend-owned and all POST routes remain explicitly enumerated with no order, balance, credential, leverage or short surface.
The UI now honors backend paper-entry and research-candidate blocks instead of offering unsafe actions.
High-risk timing, costs, gaps, feature closure, cutoffs and reconciliation invariants have deterministic coverage.

Added live-lock, dead-owner recovery, one-shot experiment, causal paper block, unsafe-store, concurrent lifecycle and UI block tests. Direct full-lab performance regression coverage remains a future opportunity.
Known WP015 reproduction runtime is 1067.810941 seconds.

A fixed-seed synthetic HGBR benchmark measured 15.9885752s scalar versus 0.0175172s batch prediction for 10,000 rows (912.7358x, max absolute difference 0). The frozen WP014-WP016 dependency identities were intentionally not changed; vectorization requires a prospectively versioned implementation and exact artifact equivalence proof.
Dependency direction and thin HTTP boundary are sound.

Experiment lab modules duplicate fold/prediction/profile orchestration and several validators embed historical package constants; consolidate only in future versioned infrastructure, not by rewriting frozen experiment code.
SEARCH_MEMORY, matched controls and parking decisions generally prevent silent tuning and preserve negative results.

The full installed-data gate was stale for paused GDELT and omitted funding/Wikimedia/current derived artifacts; it now checks the actual governed inventory. Future runners should persist stage timing and use vectorized prediction in a new code identity.

BLOCKED_BEFORE_EXECUTION. Wikimedia documents current historical aggregates and changing agent classification, but the acquired API records carry no historical vintage/publication identity proving that each value was the value available at D+2. The source-control candidate is disabled; any corrected version requires a new source design and preregistration.

research_process_summary: The governance model is coherent and conservative, but future external sources need explicit vintage guarantees before preregistration, runner attempts must remain one-shot, full-data validation must track the live manifest inventory, and repeated research orchestration should migrate to versioned deterministic batch infrastructure.
